t: Erbauer EXT 18V 4.0Ah Li-Ion power tool battery engineered for reliable and efficient performance across all compatible Erbauer 18V EXT cordless tools. Features a robust design, ideal for demanding trade applications such as construction sites and workshop environments, where sustained power and durability are crucial. The battery incorporates Keep Cool Technology to ensure extended runtime and reduce heat stress, delivering uninterrupted maximum power throughout its discharge cycle, and also significantly increasing overall battery life. Real-time feedback on remaining capacity and a clear battery charge indicator allow for efficient power management, making it an essential component for the professional user's Erbauer power tool kit.
